attempts.raw: {"risk": 3, "reason": "Touches a widely-used core file (BaseShapeTagHelper.cs) and changes rendering behavior across multiple admin views (Author/UserName display replaced with a new cached tag helper), so any bug in the new UserDisplayNameTagHelper, caching keys, or the modified attribute-lookup logic could break admin lists in many modules including third-party ones relying on those cshtml files."}

reason: Touches a widely-used core file (BaseShapeTagHelper.cs) and changes rendering behavior across multiple admin views (Author/UserName display replaced with a new cached tag helper), so any bug in the new UserDisplayNameTagHelper, caching keys, or the modified attribute-lookup logic could break admin lists in many modules including third-party ones relying on those cshtml files.
